inputs.note: Structure only: 1FTnl. text, 1FT1 v3 envelope, CFG1 v6, lockMode 2 (password). No profile values recorded anywhere.

Differs from the hash recorded in the 0.6.99 ANALYSIS.md inventory (b46e85425e6512a39bd5fde5cd5037bef7ed065ab27c704b96ce40aa3a24e0ff, 915016 B): that hash is the 0.6.99 .so, and the Unicorn oracle pins it. See ANALYSIS.md.

integration_review.scope: Server verification + codec.py fix (CFG1 v1-v6, SlowDNS) in this commit; worker redeploy + live in-app test pending. No offline port (owner decision: ONLINE ONLY).

limitations: The real .1ftnl opens ONLY with its password; without it the repo decoder reports PASSWORD_REQUIRED (verified). The password is not stored anywhere.

The server worker path rejected CFG1 v6 text files (UNSUPPORTED_PAYLOAD_VERSION) even with the correct password. Fixed in this commit (codec.py accepts v1-v6 + SlowDNS; worker path verified opening the real v6 file locally). The fix is NOT live until the worker is redeployed on the VPS. Binary 1FT1 v6 files take the other branch (1FTunnel_archivos.py -> 1FTunnel.decode) and were NOT affected by this gate.

No live end-to-end test against the deployed server was run from this VM (V2 transport needs device/session auth); the verdict on the server is the deployed code at remote head 3e4a02c0 executed locally through the exact worker entry point.
The 0.7.3 DEX is R8-obfuscated; the comparison covers non-obfuscated classes, enum values and format tokens, not a full decompile (no JADX/apktool in this VM).

The Unicorn native-KDF oracle was not re-run on the 0.7.3 .so (it pins the 0.6.99 .so hash and fixed function addresses); equivalence is proven by the real 0.7.3-exported file authenticating under the 0.7.1 key material.
manual_steps: Run tools/verify_073.py with ONEFT_PW set (env only) against a real .1ftnl to repeat the positive check.

tooling.name: verify_073.py
tooling.purpose: Envelope parse, 1FTunnel.py positive decode (password from ONEFT_PW env only), file_decoder worker-path positive (opens v6 after the codec.py fix), .so KDF-label comparison. Prints structure and codes only.

tooling.name: make_fixture_v6.py
tooling.purpose: Seal the synthetic CFG1 v6 + lockMode 2 fixture with the repo decoder's derive_key (fixed salt/nonce, dummy example.org values, password 'test-only').

tooling.name: make_fixtures_v1_v5.py
tooling.purpose: Seal synthetic CFG1 v1-v5 + lockMode 2 fixtures (same envelope/password as v6). Regression set proving the codec.py fix ADDS v6 without removing v1-v5; round-trip asserts codec.decode agrees with 1FTunnel.decode on every version (except the slowDns key, emitted by codec.py only for v6).

tooling.name: dex_compare.py
tooling.purpose: Compare non-obfuscated DEX classes, enum values and format tokens between 0.7.1 and 0.7.3 classes.dex.

tooling.name: androguard
tooling.purpose: APK manifest (package/version) and DEX class/string inspection.

tooling.name: PyCryptodome
tooling.purpose: AES-256-GCM sealing of the synthetic fixture only.

tooling.name: unicorn
